en.headline: North Kwai Chung clinic to offer evening sessions five nights a week
en.dek: From 2 October the temporarily relocated family medicine clinic will extend night clinics from Wednesday and Thursday only to Monday through Friday.
body: The Hospital Authority’s Kowloon West Cluster said on Monday that North Kwai Chung Family Medicine Clinic will extend evening outpatient sessions from two nights a week to five, starting on 2 October.

The clinic, which moved temporarily to the third floor of Ha Kwai Chung Polyclinic at 77 Lai Cho Road while its usual premises undergo renovation, currently offers evening clinics on Wednesdays and Thursdays. From Friday it will open in the evenings from Monday to Friday.

A cluster spokesperson said the change is intended to give Kwai Tsing residents more flexible access to public primary care. Appointments can be made through the family medicine telephone booking line 3157 0101 or the Book FMC function in the HA Go app.
The cluster said it would keep monitoring demand at family medicine clinics and adjust resources as needed while the renovation continues.

zh.headline: 北葵涌家庭醫學診所10月2日起夜診增至五晚
zh.dek: 暫遷至下葵涌分科診所的北葵涌家庭醫學診所，夜診將由每周兩晚增至周一至周五。
body: 醫管局九龍西醫院聯網周一公布，北葵涌家庭醫學診所將由10月2日起加強夜間門診，由每周兩晚增至五晚。
診所因內部翻新工程，暫時遷往葵涌麗祖路77號下葵涌分科診所三樓，現時只在周三及周四提供夜診。本周五起改為周一至周五晚上應診。
聯網發言人表示，措施是為配合葵青區發展及市民對公營基層醫療的需求，提供更彈性的就診選擇。市民可致電家庭醫學診所電話預約系統3157 0101，或經醫管局HA Go應用程式的「預約家庭醫學診所」功能預約。
聯網表示會繼續監察各家庭醫學診所的服務使用情況，並在翻新工程期間靈活調配資源。
